## Canonical books
- AI and Formula 1: Redefining Speed and Strategy with Intelligent Technology: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-and-formula-1-redefining-speed-and-strategy-with-intelligent-technology/ — A practical look at AI in race strategy, simulation, telemetry, and split-second decisions, without pretending the software drives the car.
- Artificial Intelligence in Veterinary Medicine: Transforming Animal Healthcare Through Innovation: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-veterinary-medicine-transforming-animal-healthcare-through-innovation/ — A grounded guide to diagnostic tools, clinic workflow, animal health data, and the judgement vets still bring to the table.
- AI-Powered Smart Grid: Revolutionizing Electricity Distribution and Generation: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-powered-smart-grid-revolutionizing-electricity-distribution-and-generation/ — A clear guide to demand forecasting, grid balancing, renewables, and the awkward bit where energy theory meets field reality.
- Artificial Intelligence in Logistics: Transforming Supply Chains for Efficiency and Sustainability: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-logistics-optimizing-efficiency-and-sustainability/ — A practical look at routing, demand forecasting, warehouse automation, and the points where supply-chain theory meets loading-bay reality.
- Artificial Intelligence and the Law: Case Studies, Challenges, and Future Trends: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-and-the-law-case-studies-and-future-trends/ — A plain-English look at legal research, contracts, evidence, compliance, and the expensive consequences of getting automated law wrong.
- Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Security: A Practical Guide to Data Breach Prevention: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-for-cyber-security-a-practical-guide-to-data-breach-prevention/ — A no-hype guide to threat detection, breach prevention, alert noise, and the security decisions humans still have to own.
- The Artificial Intelligence Revolution: From Algorithms to Consciousness: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-artificial-intelligence-revolution-from-algorithms-to-consciousness/ — A grounded tour of AI history, core ideas, big claims, and the awkward gap between impressive demos and actual intelligence.
- AI in Aviation: Transforming Safety and Sustainability: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-in-aviation-transforming-safety-and-sustainability/ — A practical guide to predictive maintenance, air traffic tools, fuel efficiency, and the safety checks aviation cannot afford to treat casually.
- AI in Maritime: Revolutionizing Shipping for Sustainability: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-in-maritime-revolutionizing-shipping-for-sustainability/ — A clear look at autonomous vessels, route planning, port logistics, emissions tracking, and the rough water beneath the sustainability pitch.
- Artificial Intelligence in Pharmaceuticals: Revolutionizing Healthcare: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-pharmaceuticals-revolutionizing-healthcare/ — A plain-English guide to drug discovery, clinical trials, treatment personalisation, and the regulatory grind behind the lab promise.
- The Autonomous Revolution: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of the Automotive Industry: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-autonomous-revolution-artificial-intelligence-and-the-future-of-the-automotive-industry/ — A grounded look at autonomous vehicles, predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing, and the liability questions parked behind the showroom shine.
- Artificial Intelligence Powered Retail: Revolutionizing Customer Experience for a Sustainable Future: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-powered-retail-revolutionizing-customer-experience-for-a-sustainable-future/ — A practical guide to recommendations, inventory, pricing, supply chains, and the point where personalisation starts feeling too personal.
- Artificial Intelligence Revolution in Manufacturing: Modernizing Operations, Maintenance, and Service Delivery: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-revolution-in-manufacturing-modernizing-operations-maintenance-and-service-delivery/ — A clear guide to predictive maintenance, production planning, quality control, and what survives contact with the plant floor.
- Artificial Intelligence in Industry: A Comprehensive Guide: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-industry-a-comprehensive-guide/ — A broad but grounded guide to automation, analytics, risk, and the industrial decisions that still need more than a dashboard.
- The Dumbening: How AI is Reshaping Our Minds: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-dumbening-how-ai-is-reshaping-our-minds/ — A sceptical look at automation, attention, memory, creativity, and the cost of outsourcing too much thinking to the machine.
- AI in Agriculture: Revolutionizing Farming for a Sustainable Future: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-in-agriculture-revolutionizing-farming-for-a-sustainable-future/ — A practical guide to crop monitoring, precision farming, weather risk, labour pressure, and the field conditions that ruin tidy demos.
- AI in Education: Reimagining Learning for Every Student: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-in-education-reimagining-learning-for-every-student/ — A clear look at personalised learning, assessment, classroom support, and where education technology helps rather than just generating paperwork.
- Artificial Intelligence in Banking: Revolutionizing Finance and Data Security: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-banking-revolutionizing-finance-and-data-security/ — A grounded guide to fraud detection, credit scoring, compliance, customer data, and the risks that keep banking AI on a short lead.
- Digital Diagnosis: How AI is Revolutionizing Healthcare: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/digital-diagnosis-how-ai-is-revolutionizing-healthcare/ — A practical look at diagnostics, triage, imaging, clinical workflow, and the point where healthcare AI still needs human judgement.
- Artificial Intelligence in Construction: Building a Sustainable Future: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-construction-building-a-sustainable-future/ — A plain-English guide to planning, safety, budgets, materials, and why construction AI has to work on sites, not just slides.
- The Artificial Intelligence Job Shift: Navigating the Future of Work: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-artificial-intelligence-job-shift-navigating-the-future-of-work/ — A no-hype look at automation, reskilling, job redesign, management pressure, and what changes when AI moves into ordinary work.
- The Future of Government: Leveraging AI to Enhance Services and Safeguard Information: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-future-of-government-leveraging-ai-to-enhance-services-and-safeguard-information/ — A plain-English look at AI in public services: what it can improve, where the risks sit, and which questions teams should ask before buying the pitch.
- Smart Buildings: AI-Powered Efficiency and Sustainability: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/smart-buildings-ai-powered-efficiency-and-sustainability/ — A grounded guide to energy management, sensors, maintenance, occupant comfort, and the building systems that still need human oversight.
- Digital Defense: The Role of AI in Modern Warfare: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/digital-defense-the-role-of-ai-in-modern-warfare/ — A sober guide to drones, intelligence, cyber operations, autonomy, and the command risks that military AI cannot wish away.
- Artificial Intelligence for Wildlife Conservation: Revolutionizing Biodiversity Protection through Technology: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-for-wildlife-conservation-revolutionizing-biodiversity-protection-through-technology/ — A practical guide to habitat monitoring, species identification, anti-poaching tools, and the field data problems conservation teams face.
- Climate Intelligence: Harnessing AI for a Greener Future: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/climate-intelligence-harnessing-ai-for-a-greener-future/ — A clear guide to emissions tracking, climate modelling, renewable planning, and the difference between useful measurement and green gloss.
- AI Revolution in Railways: Modernizing Travel for a Smarter Future: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-revolution-in-railways-modernizing-travel-for-a-smarter-future/ — A grounded look at predictive maintenance, signalling, scheduling, safety, and why railway AI has to survive real service disruption.
- Artificial Intelligence in Sports: Revolutionizing Performance and Fan Engagement: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-in-sports-revolutionizing-performance-and-fan-engagement/ — A practical look at performance data, injury prevention, scouting, fan engagement, and the judgement that still decides what happens on the pitch.
- Lights, Camera, Algorithm: AI’s Role in Modern Filmmaking: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/lights-camera-algorithm-ai-s-role-in-modern-filmmaking/ — A plain-English guide to scripts, editing, visual effects, production budgets, and where AI helps filmmaking without replacing taste.
- The AI Music Revolution: Creativity, Controversy, and Collaboration: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-ai-music-revolution-creativity-controversy-and-collaboration/ — A grounded look at composition, production, rights, collaboration, and the row that starts when software learns the tune.
- The Architects of AI: Pioneers, Breakthroughs, and the Road Ahead: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-architects-of-ai-pioneers-breakthroughs-and-the-road-ahead/ — A clear guide to the people, breakthroughs, false starts, and stubborn questions that shaped artificial intelligence.
- The House Always Knows: AI, Gambling, and the Ethics of Personalized Gaming: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-house-always-knows-ai-gambling-and-the-ethics-of-personalized-gaming/ — A sceptical guide to personalisation, gambling design, addiction risk, regulation, and why the house rarely needs extra help.
- Beyond Earth: How AI is Transforming Space Exploration: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/beyond-earth-how-ai-is-transforming-space-exploration/ — A practical look at rovers, mission planning, data analysis, autonomy, and why space AI has no room for cheerful guesswork.
- From Reporters to Robots: How AI is Reshaping Journalism: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/from-reporters-to-robots-how-ai-is-reshaping-journalism/ — A grounded guide to automated reporting, fact-checking, newsroom pressure, platform incentives, and the trust problem journalism cannot dodge.
- The AI Behind Your Feed: Personalization, Moderation, and the Future of Social Media: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/the-ai-behind-your-feed-personalization-moderation-and-the-future-of-social-media/ — A clear look at recommendations, moderation, privacy, platform incentives, and why your feed knows more than feels comfortable.
- Game AI Unleashed: From Finite State Machines to Machine Learning: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/game-ai-unleashed-from-finite-state-machines-to-machine-learning/ — A practical guide to NPC behaviour, procedural systems, player experience, and the design choices hiding behind clever game AI.
- Artificial Intelligence for Small Business: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/artificial-intelligence-for-small-business/ — A plain-English guide to using artificial intelligence in small business workflows, from marketing and admin to customer service, privacy and cost control.
- AI Agents for Everyday Work: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-agents-for-everyday-work/ — A practical guide to AI agents as controlled digital helpers for everyday work, covering tasks, boundaries, review, privacy and human judgement.
- Deepfakes, AI Scams and Synthetic Reality: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/deepfakes-ai-scams-and-synthetic-reality/ — A calm guide to deepfakes, AI scams, voice cloning and synthetic media, with practical verification habits for people and small organisations.
- AI Literacy for the Modern Workplace: https://jonathan-harris.online/ebooks/ai-literacy-for-the-modern-workplace/ — A practical workplace guide to AI literacy for managers, teams and non-technical professionals, covering prompts, policy, risk and judgement.

## Methodology and practical routes
- Editorial and evidence methodology: https://jonathan-harris.online/methodology/ — How sources are selected, claims are checked, review dates are handled and corrections are made.
- Practical AI for teams: https://jonathan-harris.online/for-teams/ — AI literacy, reading paths and practical briefing options for managers and teams.
- Media and speaking: https://jonathan-harris.online/media/ — Media, podcast guest and speaking background for Jonathan Harris on practical artificial intelligence.
- Contribute an AI case study: https://jonathan-harris.online/contribute/ — Evidence-first route for submitting a real AI deployment, result or failure for editorial review.
- Find the right AI book: https://jonathan-harris.online/book-finder/ — A deterministic book finder based on reader problem and topic.
- AI glossary cheat sheet: https://jonathan-harris.online/downloads/ai-glossary-cheat-sheet/ — Plain-English AI glossary cheat sheet offered as the newsletter lead magnet.

## Evidence guides and practical resources
- AI agents for ordinary work: useful automation without handing over the keys: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/ai-agents-for-ordinary-work/ — Evidence and practical guidance on agentic AI for everyday work, including adoption, task selection, permissions, monitoring, failure modes and the difference between useful delegation and uncontrolled automation.
- AI for small business: where the evidence supports practical adoption: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/ai-for-small-business/ — A practical evidence guide for small businesses deciding where AI can save time, where the commercial case is still uncertain and how to buy tools without turning an experiment into a data or security problem.
- AI governance and law: build controls around real uses, not slogans: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/ai-governance-and-law/ — A practical evidence guide to AI governance, legal duties and organisational controls, including literacy, accountability, data protection, security and why a policy document is not the same thing as working governance.
- AI in finance: adoption is high, autonomy is not: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/ai-in-finance/ — A source-backed guide to AI in financial services, covering adoption, third-party dependence, accountability, automation, agentic finance and the difference between widespread use and fully autonomous decisions.
- AI in healthcare: evidence, workflow and the limits of automation: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/ai-in-healthcare/ — A practical evidence guide to AI in healthcare, separating authorised products and useful workflow support from broad claims that algorithms can replace clinical judgement.
- Deepfake detection and synthetic media: verification beats guessing: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/deepfake-detection-and-synthetic-media/ — A source-backed guide to recognising and verifying synthetic media, covering provenance, labels, contextual checks, detection limits and the growing gap between “looks real” and “is verified”.
- EU AI Act Article 50: what changes on 2 August 2026: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/eu-ai-act-article-50-transparency/ — A practical evidence guide to the EU AI Act transparency obligations that begin applying on 2 August 2026, including interactive AI, AI-generated content, deepfakes and the difference between provider marking and deployer disclosure.
- Workplace AI literacy: what staff and managers actually need to know: https://jonathan-harris.online/evidence/workplace-ai-literacy/ — A source-backed guide to practical AI literacy at work: understanding capabilities, checking outputs, handling data, knowing when human judgement matters and documenting how staff are prepared for the systems they use.
- AI Agent Risk Checklist: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/ai-agent-risk-checklist/ — A pre-deployment checklist for AI agents that can call tools or take actions, focused on permissions, observability, reversibility and escalation.
- AI Procurement Questions for Small Businesses: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/ai-procurement-questions-small-businesses/ — Questions for buying AI tools without discovering the real data, security and lock-in terms after the trial has already spread through the business.
- AI in Regulated Industries Evidence Map: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/ai-regulated-industries-evidence-map/ — A compact map of primary sources for healthcare, finance, data protection, security and AI literacy, with questions to ask before relying on a vendor claim.
- Deepfake Verification Checklist: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/deepfake-verification-checklist/ — A step-by-step verification checklist for suspicious video, audio and images, designed to reduce reliance on visual guessing or a single detector score.
- EU AI Act Article 50 Readiness Checklist: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/eu-ai-act-article-50-readiness-checklist/ — A practical pre-2-August checklist for mapping AI transparency duties, notices, marking, ownership and evidence without pretending every AI use has the same obligation.
- Responsible AI Checklist for Managers: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/responsible-ai-checklist-managers/ — A practical manager checklist for ownership, data, human review, monitoring and incident handling around AI systems.
- UK Workplace AI Literacy Checklist: https://jonathan-harris.online/resources/uk-workplace-ai-literacy-checklist/ — A practical checklist for managers introducing AI at work, with role-specific literacy, data handling, output checking and escalation controls.

- AI at Work: Three-Book Reading Path: https://jonathan-harris.online/bundles/ai-at-work/ — A three-book route through the job shift, practical AI agents, and AI literacy for modern workplaces.
- AI in Health and Care: Three-Book Reading Path: https://jonathan-harris.online/bundles/ai-health-and-care/ — A practical reading path across healthcare diagnosis, pharmaceuticals, and veterinary medicine.
- AI in Regulated Industries: Law, Finance and Healthcare: https://jonathan-harris.online/bundles/ai-in-regulated-industries/ — A three-book route through AI where evidence, oversight, risk and accountability matter most.
- AI in Mobility and Logistics: Three-Book Reading Path: https://jonathan-harris.online/bundles/ai-mobility-and-logistics/ — Three perspectives on AI in aviation, logistics, and high-speed transport decision-making.
